newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire welcomes delay in any Granada bid.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire welcomes delay in any Granada bid.

text.p: Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television Holdings Plc said on Tuesday that it welcomed as long a delay as possible by neighbouring television and leisure firm Granada Plc on whether to launch a bid for Yorkshire-Tyne Tees.
Ward Thomas, chairman and chief exeutive of Yorkshire-Tyne Tees said at a news conference: "The further off it is the better," when asked about a possible bid from Granada.

Granada spent 52 million pounds in February on inreasing its stake in Yorkshire-Tyne Tees by 10 percent to almost 24 percent and a full bid had been expected following British government approval of an easing in media ownership laws.
However, Granada has not yet declared its intention, saying on August 15 it was keeping "an open mind" on whether to launch a full bid for the commercial television (ITV) company.

Yorkshire-Tyne Tees earlier reported a near-doubling in first-half pre-tax profit to 13.3 million pounds from 7.4 million but it said advertising revenues were below budget in the first half. Its shares were 30p lower at 12.10 stg.
